methods.what: Definition of conjugate variables n, ν from quadratic form with coefficients a and inverse α
Variation of momentum-like variables via derivatives of inverse coefficients (geodesic-type equation)
Variation condition derived from varying the quadratic form
Mixed variation condition for the bilinear form
Expression of commutator-type combination through derivatives of α
Second-variation expansion of the quadratic/bilinear forms
